D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR[IA EXERCITVS]

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine I (AD330-335). Sear (1970 p.316 no. 3786). Obverse: Diademed and draped bust right Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG Reverse: Two soldiers standing either side of two standards Reverse inscription: GLOR[IA EXERCITVS] Mint mark: illegible Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 17.44mm; weight: 1.32g. Reference: Sear, D R. 1970.…
